profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a diverse background and history of producing high-quality back-end code. Quick learner and excellent communicator who can easily integrate into a new team with new technologies and contribute quickly. Experience ranging from highly-secure defense contracts to customer-facing web applications serving thousands of customers. Comfortable working in a collaborative, team environment as well as owning products end-to-end even in a remote workplace.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the team responsible for designing, building and maintaining the software infrastructure to support the contact center for Capital One’s retail bank customers. Focused on creating reliable, scalable and highly-available solutions to optimize the customer experience using cloud-based, serverless architecture built on AWS

Integrated AWS lambda functions in AWS Connect application averaging 100k invocations per day
Designed and implemented APIs to support highly-sensitive human data transfers with a third-party vendor
APIs deployed in a serverless architecture with R53, ALBs, and lambdas for multi-region resiliency and scaling
Implemented robust unit, integration and performance testing
Designed and built tokenization service to handle proprietary information being sent to vendors
Tokens generated and retrieved by lambdas and stored in DynamoDB
Implemented monitoring with AWS Cloudwatch
CloudWatch alarms and custom metrics combined with PagerDuty allowed for 24/7 monitoring and alerting
Integrated lambda functions with CloudWatch X-Ray for detailed tracing and quick debugging
Implemented observability with third party platforms like New Relic and OpenTelemetry
Designed easy to use dashboards for product owners to gain insights into customer behavior

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: SQL · FastAPI · Scripting · Terraform · GitHub · CircleCI · Python (Programming Language) · Django

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the simulation department implementing real-time training systems. Ensured fidelity of simulation code with test driven development.
